name: Streaming physics
description: World streaming with physics (p353 Phase 4): 12 × 12 cells of 64 m, each a ground slab, a pile of 14 crates in the tier policy and, along the middle row, a jointed chain lying across the cell's edge, all code content. A kinematic plough, the streaming and the policy focus, mows along the middle row on fixed steps and pushes crates over the cells' edges. Crates are tinted by tier: orange FULL (the policy, near the plough), blue STATIC (the policy, further off in a RESIDENT cell), grey DISABLED (a NEARBY cell's: the scene's nearbyPhysicsTier). A crate belongs to the cell it's in, so one pushed along with the plough stays with it; a chain in a NEARBY cell is STATIC (a jointed body is never DISABLED), and one lying across into a NEARBY cell simulates with its RESIDENT half.

debugData.description: Follows the plough (a FOLLOW component, added in streamingPhysics.ts). The streaming focus is the plough, not this camera.
